title: Minimax Causal Effect-Subspace Estimation under History-Predictable Assignment with Recorded Propensities
banked_reason: The central theorem proves only c b_nm <= R*_nm <= C(1 wedge a_loose_nm); the fixed-complexity upper endpoint is nonshrinking, so the achieved tier is subfield below the field floor.
gap_reasons: The proposed matched b_nm IPW--SVD frontier is replaced by a loose a^{loose}_{nm} bound and an open minimax bracket; retain and position this as the weaker delivered kernel, not as the promised frontier.
The central theorem proves only c b_nm <= R*_nm <= C(1 wedge a^{loose}_{nm}), and under the fixed-complexity subregime the upper endpoint is nonshrinking.
proof_attempt_summary: The run pursued a martingale-sharp IPW--SVD upper bound, matching constant-propensity minimax converse, blind-drift equivalence, and simultaneous bands under predictable masks. A same-class endogenous-target construction refuted uniform b_nm attainment by recorded IPW--SVD; matrix-Freedman arguments yielded only a_loose_nm, while a deterministic sine-frame hybrid reduced the minimax upper endpoint to C(1 wedge a_loose_nm). The estimator-independent rate between c b_nm and that constant endpoint remains open, and standard shrinking routes would require exogeneity or singular-factor predictability absent from the frozen class.
tldr: Recorded propensities identify the causal effect matrix and make the IPW errors a bounded row-major martingale-difference array.  The strongest uniform same-risk statement on the frozen predictable class is now \(c b_{nm}\le\inf_{\widetilde U}\sup_P E_P[\mathcal L(\widetilde U,U)]\le\sup_P E_P[\mathcal L(\widehat U^{\mathrm H},U)]\le C(1\wedge a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm})\), where \(\widehat U^{\mathrm H}\) is an explicit hybrid of recorded IPW--SVD and a deterministic discrete-sine frame.  Recorded IPW--SVD separately retains its \(C a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm}\) expected-risk guarantee and its estimator-specific obstruction.  Nonemptiness of the bounded-outcome class forces \(\lambda_{nm}\le2B\sqrt{nm}\); with fixed \(r,\mu,K,q\) and bounded aspect ratio this gives \(b_{nm}\gtrsim\sqrt{\log n/n}\) but \(a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm},d_{nm}\gtrsim\sqrt{\log n}\), so the available uniform stochastic resolutions do not shrink.  The minimax rate between the lower scale and a constant remains open.  Blind row scaling is certified only at \(d_{nm}\), the rank-one \(0.25/0.75\) Markov law remains a HeartSteps II stress design, and simultaneous dense-query radii retain their separate \(\sqrt{\log|\mathcal G_n|}\) factor.
gap: Mehrotra et al. establish the geometric rowwise matrix-error scale for an armwise row-scaled SVD under independent Bernoulli assignments, but not an effect-subspace theorem under history-predictable assignment or a minimax converse over estimators observing recorded propensities. Cai et al.'s independent-entry subspace bounds, Han et al.'s online matrix-context regression, Dwivedi et al.'s adaptive nearest-neighbor arm-mean inference, Athey et al.'s causal-panel Frobenius completion, and Sun et al.'s longitudinal MAR weighted completion do not fill that joint gap. Khan and Ugander's scalar affine normalization does not analyze the new row-fraction SVD or supply an observed spectral drift diagnostic.
fill: The project derives a maximum-row upper rate and measurable-estimator converse, proves the primitive-gap-to-tangent-gap transfer, calibrates the observable blind-versus-recorded discrepancy, gives an iff frontier and a bounded-aspect boundary example for the newly defined blind procedure, and derives Belloni--Oliveira increment and covariance conditions plus uniformly positive leave-one-cell-out studentizers for a direct-IPW multiplier band with a separate family-size factor.
